counting_rule.canonical_record: One retained bibliographic record per separately citable work or separately citable version.
counting_rule.independent_family: Versions, extensions, or consolidations of the same study count once; author overlap alone does not merge independent studies.
counting_rule.operational_resource: Code, data, and service resources are counted outside the scholarly corpus and receive no fabricated publication year.
